categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in CNC precision machinery manufacturing, focusing on PCB drilling and forming machines, semiconductor measurement and inspection equipment, and other precision machinery including optical and engraving machines. It also engages in intellectual property and leasing businesses. Recently, it has expanded into medical device production and sales through a subsidiary.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops proprietary software control systems integrated into high-end PCB equipment, enabling multi-axis simultaneous independent processing and CCD digital control technology for enhanced precision and efficiency. It also develops advanced semiconductor measurement and inspection technologies, including AOI and metrology for 3D IC packaging, wafer warpage, and flux jetting inspection. Manufacturing involves precision CNC machining with strong R&D in automation and intelligent integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include PCB manufacturers, semiconductor wafer and packaging producers, and industries requiring precision machining such as electronics, automotive, and consumer electronics sectors. The company serves global markets with a focus on high-end PCB and semiconductor equipment users, including AI server and automotive electronics manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing bases and subsidiaries in mainland China (Nanjing, Lianshui, Kunshan). It has sales and service presence in Asia including Korea, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, and also targets Southeast Asian markets. It maintains a global sales network with emphasis on Asian regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of precision CNC machinery and semiconductor inspection equipment, providing critical production equipment to PCB and semiconductor manufacturers downstream. It also offers after-sales services and software solutions integrated with its hardware.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core technology capabilities, developing advanced, high-specification, automated, intelligent, and fully integrated equipment. R&D focuses on multi-axis drilling machines, advanced semiconductor metrology and AOI systems, and automation enhancements. The company emphasizes innovation in AI and smart manufacturing technologies to maintain market leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of high-value precision machinery and semiconductor inspection equipment. Additional income streams include leasing and intellectual property licensing. The company also derives revenue from after-sales services and software solutions integrated with its equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Competitors include domestic Taiwanese firms such as Dongtai, Longze, Ender, Youjia, Lison, and Dahang, as well as international manufacturers from Germany, Japan, and China. The company positions itself as a high-end, innovative equipment supplier with proprietary software and strong R&D, maintaining competitive advantages in precision, automation, and customer customization.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of approximately NT$2.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, doubling from the previous year, with net profit rising significantly to NT$124 million. Total assets reached about NT$5.2 billion, with steady growth in equity and capital. R&D investment remains substantial, supporting sustained growth and profitability improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly precise, efficient, and customizable CNC machinery with proprietary control software, enabling superior processing accuracy and integration with intelligent cloud management. Its semiconductor inspection equipment provides comprehensive metrology and defect detection tailored to advanced packaging needs. The combination of strong R&D, automation, and customer-centric innovation differentiates it from competitors.
